description: Use this when the user names one known video and wants its licence, attribution, metadata, captions or a direct file link. Pass ref: a Commons file title such as "File:Ocean_surface_waves_06.ogv", an Internet Archive identifier such as "cat_with_green_shining_eye" or its URL, or a YouTube watch URL. Returns download_url (the one link to give the user: a direct file, the file list when no video file is listed, or null), files (every direct video and caption file listed) and captions (caption files only, vtt or srt). A YouTube URL returns title and channel only, with no download and no caption file. An item with no free licence returns not_free and no link. Not for a topic search (use search_free_videos). We do not rip videos from social platforms or remove watermarks. A TikTok, Instagram, X, Douyin, Bilibili or Xiaohongshu link returns not_offered and is not fetched.

ref.description: One item. Example call: {"ref": "File:Ocean_surface_waves_06.ogv"}. Also a Commons page URL, an Internet Archive identifier ("cat_with_green_shining_eye") or details URL, or a YouTube watch URL

name: video_metadata

attribution.description: Ready to paste next to a reuse of the file

captions.description: Caption files the source lists, each a direct link. Empty for Commons and YouTube

format.description: Caption file format: vtt (WebVTT) or srt (SubRip)

url.description: Direct link to the caption file

captions_note.description: Why captions are or are not listed

creator.description: Creator or YouTube channel, or null when not stated

download_url.description: The one link to hand the user: a direct video file when download_kind is file, the item's file list when it is directory, and null when none (YouTube or a refusal)

error.description: Present when status is not ok: a stable code, what went wrong and what to do next.

code.description: Stable code: not_offered, no_results, not_found, not_free or source_unavailable

hint.description: The next step: which tool to call or what input to change

message.description: What went wrong, in one or two sentences

explanation.description: Why no download is given, for YouTube, not_free and not_offered answers

files.description: Every video file (up to 6) and caption file (up to 4) the source lists, each with a direct link. Use it to offer another size or format

bytes.description: File size in bytes, or null when the source does not state it

kind.description: video: a playable video file. caption: a subtitle file

mime.description: Media type or the source's format name, or null when not stated

name.description: File name in the source record

licence.description: The licence name exactly as the source record states it. Null for YouTube, which gives no reuse licence

licence_note.description: Reminder that the licence is what the source states

licence_url.description: Link to the licence text, empty when the source gives none, null for YouTube

page_url.description: The item's page on the source site

source.description: The source read, with its link

status.description: ok: record found. not_found: no such item. not_free: the item states no free licence, so no link is given. unavailable: the source did not answer, retry later. not_offered: a platform this service does not fetch

title: Video metadata and captions
